title: Open-Weight Fine-Tuning Defenses: Reproducing the Simple-Attack Break

original_idea.body: Multilingual jailbreak-intention probe transfer (extends arXiv:2606.11202): compute an English-only refusal direction, test per-language AUROC across 5 translated languages vs per-language fitting; report cross-lingual transfer gap.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Cross-lingual transfer of intent probes addresses a known low-resource-language bypass; concrete chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Activation direction + MT-translated prompts + per-language AUROC; bounded and guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused cross-lingual transfer-gap deliverable; translation across 5 languages adds effort.

novelty.reasoning: English-only-direction transfer question likely not directly answered; mostly novel.
